attributes.name: Conch of the Tritons
attributes.powers: For your combat check, recharge this card to draw a random monster from the box. Use the drawn card's highest difficulty to defeat as the result of your check, adding 1d8 if the drawn card has the Aquatic trait, then banish the drawn card. Characters may not play other cards or use powers on this check. If you fail the check, the bane is undefeated; reduce any damage dealt by it to 0.

corrections.corrected_text: On the loot Conch of the Tritons, change "No other cards may be used on this check" to "Characters may not play other cards or use powers on this check".
corrections.issue: Conch of the Tritons says other cards can't be used on the check. What about character powers?
